one_line: Clown-only gimmick props: a throwable/self-activating banana-copter and a clown-built creampie-torium that turns cremated bodies into pies.
player_facing_mechanics: Examine a clown_prop to see remaining uses ("infinite" or a count)
Use (activate) a clown_prop by hand only if you have a clown job and are wearing clown uniform, otherwise gets a 'not silly enough' notice
Try to use a prop on cooldown and get a 'still reseting' message
Using a prop spends one use and destroys the item when uses run out

spinning_banana (banana-copter): 5 uses, ties the banana around your waist, locks you facing south, immobilizes you, floats you up/down, spins the banana sprite, plays a sound, then returns the item to your hand
Examine crematorium as a clown to be told it can become a creampie-torium with bananium
Attack a crematorium with a bananium sheet to consume one sheet and convert it into a creampie-torium
Cremating bodies in a creampie-torium turns every contained living mob into a cream pie that is placed inside it
tg_systems_used: job/role checks (is_clown_job, mind.assigned_role) and clothing-type check (w_uniform)
data_only_parts: clown_prop names, descriptions, icon and icon_state values
uses_left count and default infinite (-1) value
logic_parts: attack_self gating on clown job + clown uniform + cooldown + use decrement + Destroy
activate() proc dispatch to per-prop behavior
spinning_banana/activate flail animation, immobilize, dir lock, sound, and move_back return-to-hand
lock_dir/user_tried_turn signal handler blocking direction changes
crematorium attacked_by bananium conversion (use sheet, new creampie, copy dir/id)
creampie cremate override spawning pies and adding the tweak component
byond_specific: matrix() and animate() chained animations with flags = ANIMATION_CONTINUE
span_* macros (span_info, span_notice, span_suicide) and playsound
port_notes: Mostly data plus a little behavior. Two entity prototypes (clown prop base + banana-copter, crematorium/creampie-torium) map cleanly, and the creampie conversion becomes a construction graph node (bananium sheet -> creampie-torium) with the cremation handled by a body-container system event. The banana-copter's flail/spin/immobilize/dir-lock needs real code: a Use-in-hand event gated on clown job + worn uniform, a DoAfter or status-effect-based immobilize, a direction-lock component, and a sprite overlay driven by an animation system (no direct matrix/animate equivalent). Design questions: should the clown-only gating and cooldown stay hardcoded, and how faithful must the pixel_z bob/spin be versus a simpler generic animation?
